title: InviteList
description: Maintain security and an active community by allowing pre-existing server members to invite other players to the whitelist.
body:
![InviteList Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e707296a5aec559e767fddc9884ca98446c749f2.png)

### Features:

- Adds an invite system to the whitelist.
- Check who invited who in the userdata.
- Really, really simple!

### Commands/Permissions

Commands:

`/invite <player>` - Use this to invite players to the server. (in-game or through console)
`/invitelist help` - Lists available commands
`/invitelist site` - Provides a link to the modrinth page.

Permissions:

`invitelist.invite` - A **default** permission that allows players to invite people. Use something like [LuckPerms](https://modrinth.com/plugin/luckperms) to remove it.

### Issues

Please report all issues/errors on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/ItsMitlit/InviteList/issues)
